### The Promise of Humility
Author: C.J. Mahaney
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/the-promise-of-humility-1383596.html
Passage: Isaiah 66:2
Points:
- While the world sometimes admires humility for practical reasons, biblical humility uniquely captures the gaze and favor of God.
- God redirected ancient Israel away from religious pride and ritual trappings toward a contrite heart that trembles at His Word.
- True humility acts as a magnet for God's unmerited favor, inviting His active strength and supernatural help.
- Genuine humility is rooted in evaluating ourselves honestly in light of God's perfect holiness and our sinfulness.
- Pursuing humility rather than self-exaltation ensures that our lives, families, and labors carry lasting spiritual value.

### What Does it Take to be Esteemed by God?
Author: K.P. Yohannan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/what-does-it-take-to-be-esteemed-by-god-1357942.html
Passage: Isaiah 66:2
Points:
- Human nature naturally runs contrary to God's values by craving recognition, status, self-sufficiency, and worldly importance.
- God values a broken, contrite, and reverent heart far above human talent, intelligence, or outward capability.
- The continuing work of the cross is meant to break our stubborn self-will so the life of Christ can freely flow through us.
- Unbroken pride shows itself through touchiness, self-defense, criticizing others, and reluctance to confess faults.
- Believers must examine their hearts and willingly surrender areas of self-will to be revived by God's presence.
